subject: Compliance calendar sync: ISO 27001 scope and FedRAMP readiness readout
messages:
From: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:15:00Z
Subject: Compliance kickoff — ISO scope + FedRAMP readiness questions

Hi Mina,

Thanks for agreeing to sync on our upcoming assessment cadence. We're preparing Acme's vendor intake for the combined ISO 27001 readout and a FedRAMP readiness check. A few items we need to confirm from Redwood before we lock an audit window:

- Preferred audit windows: Jul 12-16 or Jul 26-30. Please confirm which works.
- Evidence upload deadline: prefer vendors upload evidence 10 business days before the start of the window (so Jul 2 or Jul 16 respectively). Can you commit?
- ISO scope: we saw the draft scope you shared earlier. Can you confirm whether the scope includes (a) hosted API (public tier), (b) Dedicated GPU clusters, (c) Private VPC offering? We need a line-by-line scope confirmation for our ISMS mapping.
- FedRAMP: are you targeting Low or Moderate impact level for readiness? Also we will need sample artifacts for: encryption key rotation logs, KMS integration diagram, network boundary diagrams, and evidence of role-based access controls (RBAC) for console.
- Retention windows: auditors will ask for 90/180-day logs for key services (auth, admin changes, KMS key events). Do you have these readily available?

Attachments: requested_evidence_list.csv (CSV stub)

Can you nominate control owners and get an initial upload to a shared Drive by July 2 if you prefer the earlier window? If not, Jul 16 is acceptable for the later window.

Regards,
Lara
Lara Gomez
Senior Security Manager — Acme Corp

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance kickoff — ISO scope + FedRAMP readiness questions

Lara — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned to support the Jul 26-30 window (gives us the best runway). We will commit to evidence upload by 2027-07-15.

Quick answers and next steps:
- Scope confirmation: our ISMS scope will include: Hosted API (hosted tier), Redwood Dedicated pools (reserved capacity), and Redwood Private (VPC deployments). We'll provide a table mapping product features to ISO controls in the shared Drive.
- FedRAMP target: currently doing a readiness assessment for Moderate. We'll surface any control gaps in the readiness report.
- Logs/retention: auth logs and admin change logs are stored for 180 days in our central logging cluster; KMS key events are retained 90 days by default — we can extract rotation events beyond that range if needed (we keep longer audit trails in the HSM audit repo on request).
- Control owners: see the list below. I'll ask each owner to upload initial artifacts.
  - Identity & Access: Kimberly Park
  - Crypto & KMS: Jonas Weber
  - Network & Perimeter: Marissa Cole
  - Evidence Index / Packaging: Mina Haddad (me)

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme-Compliance/2027-evidence (we'll drop the evidence_index_template.xlsx there.)

Attachment: evidence_index_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Next meeting? I can do a 30-minute readout tomorrow at 2pm PT to walk through owners and upload plan. LMK if that works for you.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance kickoff — ISO scope + FedRAMP readiness questions

Mina / team — quick technical notes to include in the evidence bundle (Jonas):

- KMS: we use AWS KMS for hosted and Dedicated; Private deployments can be customer-managed KMS. I'll export a redacted KMS rotation log excerpt and an architecture diagram showing envelope encryption flow. See attached snippet.
- HSM / rotation history: HSM event retention is longer but stored in an internal HSM audit repo (we will surface slices only). If the FedRAMP auditor needs chain-of-custody for keys older than 90 days, we can provide an extract under an NDA addendum.
- Network diagram: attached network_diagram_v2.pdf — includes VPC peering, NAT gateways, and audit logging endpoints. For Private customers, we will call out customer-managed network boundaries separately.
- Evidence packaging: please use the evidence_index_template.xlsx and include a pointer to the internal EAD (Evidence Accession ID) that our ingest script generates. That will make it easier for auditors to reference artifacts.

Attachment: kms_rotation_log_excerpt.txt (text/plain)
Attachment: network_diagram_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

On the FedRAMP impact level: Moderate items to watch — continuous monitoring controls and vulnerability management cadence. We'll highlight compensating controls in the readiness report.

-Jonas
Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer
From: Paul Kim <paul.kim@auditor-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance kickoff — ISO scope + FedRAMP readiness questions

Thanks for the details. Auditor notes:

- Jul 26-30 is acceptable; we'll schedule three concurrent streams (network/app/ops). Please ensure evidence for each stream is uploaded by 2027-07-15.
- We will sample 25% of production instances for network and KMS events; please mark any environment that should be out-of-scope in the Drive.
- Deliverables we need by 7/15: evidence_index.xlsx, KMS rotation audit slice, network diagram, RBAC screenshots for admin console, SOC 2 bridge letter or last SOC 2 report (if available).
- Response SLA during the assessment: 48 hours for questions; please nominate a primary contact for faster escalation.

If you can upload the SOC 2 bridge letter, that will accelerate the readiness conversation. Otherwise we'll proceed based on the evidence you provide and make gap observations in our readout.

-Paul Kim
Senior Assessor, Auditor Corp

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Paul Kim <paul.kim@auditor-corp.com>, Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance kickoff — ISO scope + FedRAMP readiness questions

Paul / Lara — confirmed: Redwood will target the Jul 26-30 assessment window and will upload the requested artifacts by 2027-07-15.

Primary contact during the assessment: Mina Haddad (email below) — for operational escalations please use the 48-hour SLA and I'll triage to the right owner.

SOC 2: we are preparing a bridge letter and will upload it to the Drive by 2027-07-01 to give the audit team a head start.

Action items (owners):
- Evidence index upload (evidence_index_template.xlsx) — Mina Haddad — due 2027-07-15
- KMS rotation logs & HSM extract (redacted) — Jonas Weber — due 2027-07-10
- Network diagram & sample flow logs — Marissa Cole — due 2027-07-10
- RBAC screenshots & admin audit trail — Kimberly Park — due 2027-07-12

We'll plan a pre-audit readiness call on 2027-07-18 to walk auditors through the bundle and surface any early gaps.

Thanks — we'll be in touch if anything changes.

Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
